title: DGE subject-club office-bearer election circular, 2026-05-20, public mirror
signature_verification: Visible block inspected; no cryptographic validation performed.
notes: Both pages read visually and independently checked. AEOs convene the general body of new school-club office-bearers and elect subdistrict office-bearers; DDEs convene the new subdistrict general body and elect district office-bearers. Working committees are to be constituted per the manual and secretaries’ particulars reported. Targets do not prove elections occurred or identify appointed office-bearers. School-election completion is not the stated meaning of the subdistrict target. Four subject streams only; no IT/Little Kites or state-club term supplied. Public mirror hosting is distinct from the visible departmental document; an original government-hosted copy was not recovered in the bounded lookup.
